title: Variational Loop Vertex Expansion for Cumulants
summary: Extending recent advances on constructive quantum field theory, we study cumulants of one of the simplest matrix models in the regime of bounded rank. We analyze both ordinary cumulants and scalar cumulants, which arise from the Weingarten calculus and are essential to the topological expansion in quantum field theory. Our results are valid for arbitrarily large positive coupling and provide new instances where techniques such as the variational approach are applied to cu- mulants.
